select 'PPP' src, BORROWER_NAME nm, null addr, BORROWER_CITY city, BORROWER_ZIP zip, NAICS_CODE::string naics, DATE_APPROVED::string dt, CURRENT_APPROVAL_AMOUNT::string amt, JOBS_REPORTED::string jobs, BUSINESS_AGE x
from LIBRARY_MARTS.ECONOMICS.ECONOMICS__FED_SBA_PPP where BORROWER_STATE='TX' and upper(BORROWER_NAME) like 'TEXAS HEALTHCARE SOLUTION%'
union all
select 'PPP150K', BORROWERNAME, BORROWERADDRESS, BORROWERCITY, BORROWERZIP, NAICSCODE::string, DATEAPPROVED::string, CURRENTAPPROVALAMOUNT::string, JOBSREPORTED::string, BUSINESSAGEDESCRIPTION||' / '||coalesce(BUSINESSTYPE,'')
from LIBRARY_MARTS.ECONOMICS.ECONOMICS__FED_SBA_PPP_LOANS_150K_PLUS where BORROWERSTATE='TX' and upper(BORROWERNAME) like 'TEXAS HEALTHCARE SOLUTION%'
union all
select 'NPPES', PROVIDER_ORGANIZATION_NAME_LEGAL_BUSINESS_NAME||' / '||coalesce(PROVIDER_OTHER_ORGANIZATION_NAME,''), PROVIDER_FIRST_LINE_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS||' '||coalesce(PROVIDER_SECOND_LINE_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS,''), PROVIDER_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS_CITY_NAME, NPI::string, HEALTHCARE_PROVIDER_TAXONOMY_CODE_1, PROVIDER_ENUMERATION_DATE::string, AUTHORIZED_OFFICIAL_FIRST_NAME||' '||AUTHORIZED_OFFICIAL_LAST_NAME, NPI_DEACTIVATION_DATE::string, regexp_replace(PROVIDER_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS_TELEPHONE_NUMBER,'[^0-9]','')
from LIBRARY_MARTS.HEALTH.HEALTH__FED_CMS_NPPES where PROVIDER_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS_STATE_NAME='TX' and ENTITY_TYPE_CODE in ('2','2.0') and (upper(PROVIDER_ORGANIZATION_NAME_LEGAL_BUSINESS_NAME) like 'TEXAS HEALTHCARE SOLUTION%' or upper(PROVIDER_OTHER_ORGANIZATION_NAME) like 'TEXAS HEALTHCARE SOLUTION%' or PROVIDER_FIRST_LINE_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS ilike '7551 CALLAGHAN%' or regexp_replace(PROVIDER_BUSINESS_PRACTICE_LOCATION_ADDRESS_TELEPHONE_NUMBER,'[^0-9]','')='2108775222')
rows: Existing or more than 2 years old / Subchapter S Corporation
Existing or more than 2 years old
